text:
Sofia: FYI FRA gateway held our inbound truck. Customs says HS 8471 reclassification -> paperwork mismatch. Carrier put pallet on hold at FRA-GTW. AWB: 987-65432100. PO RDW-74200. Vendor offers split: air priority for 6 H100s, remaining 14 by sea. Need quick call: accept air (~\u20ac13,200) or clear paperwork (~3 days) and keep full shipment intact. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Marco (AtlasShip): Confirmed hold. Reason: commodity description doesn't match EU tariff line. We can pull 6 serials for immediate air (ETA ~36-48h) and move rest by sea (~9-12d). Expedited estimate \u20ac13,200 incl urgent broker fee + AWB. If you sign amendment now can reduce to \u20ac8,500 with credit on next PO and waive one-day storage.

Priya: Finance flag 3k? Not unless we get credit. Can we get serial continuity and device firmware parity? Need batch SNs contiguous for our tagging pipeline.

Marco (AtlasShip): Yes SNs contiguous. Air batch SNs: H100-PL-10001..10006. Sea SNs: H100-PL-10007..10020. Firmware image v3.2.1 on all units. We'll attach manifest + signed commercial invoice once amendment signed.

Devon: ops ask: if we go air, request FRA depot QC hold: do not push units to provisioning automation until depot confirms photos + POST pass. Also open provisional RMA for DOA to speed replacements.

ops-bot: Created task `task-rdw-74200-depot-qc` assigned to @Devon. Checklist: inbound photos, serial reconciliation, 30m burn-in, dmesg snapshot, power-on POST.

Kira: Infra note 32: rack onboarding window in FRA-1 this week is tight. If units arrive in 48h, we need 48-72h to physically mount + KMS injection testing. Customer rollouts may shift by ~2 days. Please tag cost center INFRA-EDGE in amendment.

Priya: Marco, can you push Marco (AtlasShip) discount down to \u20ac8k firm? We'll accept at that price. Otherwise close the truck release and clear with customs (longer).

Marco (AtlasShip): I can do \u20ac8,200 if PO amendment is executed within 30m. Need PO amendment referencing RDW-74200 and bill-to: "Redwood Inference". We'll generate AWB ABF987654321 and send carrier pickup pics.

Sofia: Do it. Priya, confirm cost-center coding INFRA-EDGE. Devon, hope you can pick up depot task.

Priya: Confirmed INFRA-EDGE. Approving up to \u20ac8,200. Send amendment to procurement@redwood.ai now.

Marco (AtlasShip): Amendment sent and proforma attached to Sofia email. Pre-sending RMA for DOA: RMA-RDW-26-045. Prepaid return labels attached. Carrier ETA update in 20m.

Devon: Quick pre-hold logs from our staging controller before ship hold:
```
$ kubectl -n infra logs provisioner-rc | tail -n 10
2026-04-02T14:03:12Z provisioner: reconcile complete
2026-04-02T14:03:16Z inventory: inbound 0 -> pending 1
2026-04-02T14:03:20Z health: routing-latency 3ms, all nodes nominal
```
No anomalies.

Theo: (infra) I'll reserve 3U rack space FRA-1 bay-4 and pre-stage rails + PDUs. Expect ~2 man-hours per unit to mount. Ping once depot photos uploaded.

Sofia: Marco 30: please include customs broker contact and signed commercial invoice PDF to customs@redwood.ai + billing. Need to avoid another hold. Also request carrier pickup photos and serial manifest.

Marco (AtlasShip): Will send broker contact + signed invoice to both addresses in 15m. Carrier pickup photos attached to the AWB email when available.

Sofia: Great. Closing thread for now; will reopen on depot upload. :white_check_mark:

Devon: Follow-up: when depot task is done, upload photos to `task-rdw-74200-depot-qc` and tag infra + ops. I'll run POST and burn-in and mark RMA if DOA.

Priya: thx everyone.
